nodes.label: Hosted Edge API Priority
nodes.rationale: Hosted trial and production behavior must be changed in Supabase Edge Functions, while app/ is only a local reference.

nodes.label: Repository Sources of Truth
nodes.rationale: The repository guidance assigns authoritative locations for hosted API behavior, migrations, local Python reference behavior, generated artifacts, and operational documentation.

nodes.label: Forward-Compatible Migrations
nodes.rationale: Hosted database recovery must use a new corrective migration rather than deleting migration history or resetting the database.

nodes.label: Local Development Security Boundary
nodes.rationale: Generated signing keys, real environment files, OAuth credentials, and local Supabase state are ignored by Git; local authentication bypass is limited to the Python-only local mode.

nodes.label: Credentials and Trust Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Runtime Supabase secrets remain inside Edge Functions; mobile apps may contain only their matching project URL and publishable key, never privileged credentials.

nodes.label: Hosted Edge API Exclusivity
nodes.rationale: Trial and production run the Supabase Edge API exclusively; the Python API remains a local reference implementation for development and contract tests.

nodes.label: Trial and Production Environment Isolation
nodes.rationale: Trial deploys automatically after successful main CI, while production requires manual GitHub Actions execution and protected-environment approval.

nodes.label: Protected Production Release
nodes.rationale: Production deployment is manually dispatched from main, requires a successful CI run for that revision, and is guarded by the production environment.
